slides.label: AI infra security · Oct 9, 2026
slides.title: Two critical AI bugs. One mistake: trusting localhost
slides.body: CVSS 9.8 in LMCache, 9.4 in DeepSeek Harness

slides.label: The setup
slides.title: Where the trust broke
slides.body: LMCache shares vLLM's KV cache over ZeroMQ. DeepSeek Harness runs coding agents behind a local HTTP API.

slides.label: LMCache
slides.title: One message runs code
slides.body: An unauthenticated socket unpickles the payload before any check. Official images run it as root.

slides.label: LMCache
slides.title: Fixed versions today
slides.body: 0.3.9 through 0.5.5 are affected. JFrog says keep the port off routable addresses.

slides.label: DeepSeek Harness
slides.title: The agent freed itself
slides.body: The API trusted the Host header. The sandbox left loopback open, so one command lifted it.

slides.label: DeepSeek Harness
slides.title: GitHub stars in weeks
slides.body: Fixed in 0.1.2-alpha.1. A coding agent can reach your SSH keys and cloud credentials.

slides.label: My take
slides.title: Localhost is not authentication
slides.body: Authenticate every internal socket, never unpickle network data, and sandbox the network, not just the disk.
